text.name: ABM Treaty Withdrawal
text.rules: LIO chooses: Leave the treaty? If yes, record "treaty gone", then LIO spends 2 points, then SAE spends 1 point, then raise Escalation by 1; if no, LIO spends 1 point.
text.history: The United States gave notice of withdrawal from the 1972 Anti-Ballistic Missile Treaty on 13 December 2001; the withdrawal took effect on 13 June 2002.
